6 التَّفَايُصُ is said to be the original and regular form of التَّفَاوُصُ, which signifies The speaking, talking, or discoursing, each to another, or each with another: the ى being changed into و because of the dammeh. (M in this art. and in art. فوص, and TA.) ―
-b2- See also another explanation in art. فوص: and see 4 in the present art.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
